title: Angi × Ex-Grubhub | Marketplace operators, partner builders
intro: Grubhub alumni understand two-sided marketplaces, enterprise partnerships, sales and operational performance. These seven profiles are mapped to Angi's Large Pro, Enterprise Sales and Sales Enablement teams. Browse the teams, explore backgrounds and select people for an introduction. Kristen le Roux directly expressed interest in Elizabeth Doll and Michael Cognetti for Senior Account Partner; she noted similar Associate Director openings were close to being filled. Hiring contact labels distinguish direct recruiter conversations from broader team hiring signals. Candidate interest, applications and current job status require confirmation.

items.role: Senior Account Partner, Large Pro Partnerships
items.note: Kristen le Roux directly expressed interest in Elizabeth for this Senior Account Partner position. Angi needs someone who can build high-value service-pro relationships and grow partnership performance. Elizabeth has enterprise relationship and partner investment experience; confirm portfolio retention/expansion ownership, analytics, and commercial accountability. The similar Associate Director openings are reportedly close to being filled.

items.role: Senior Account Partner, Large Pro Partnerships
items.note: Kristen le Roux directly expressed interest in Michael for this Senior Account Partner position and described the scope and compensation as practically identical to the similar Associate Director role, which is reportedly close to being filled. Michael has senior strategic-partnership and account-management experience; verify direct commercial ownership, expansion and negotiation.

Angi needs an analytical partner adviser who can grow and retain major pro accounts. Corey has led enterprise partner growth, investment and monetization initiatives; verify hands-on portfolio ownership, recurring business reviews, and BI-tool fluency rather than assuming her marketing leadership equals account management.

Angi needs an enterprise hunter comfortable with senior stakeholders and ambitious new-business targets. Chip's enterprise sales and new-business development history is relevant; verify $1M+ annual quota attainment, new-logo deal cycles, and travel requirements.

Angi needs someone to mine marketplace partner data, build financial cases, and lead multi-team improvements. Christian brings marketplace process improvement and automation experience; verify directly owned analysis, financial modeling, executive recommendations, and willingness to take a hands-on strategy role.

Angi needs a data-driven Large Pro strategist who can spot performance issues and execute partner-growth initiatives. Jonathan's ownership of market operating metrics and weather-impact analysis maps to diagnostic work; validate partner-facing influence, financial business cases, and cross-functional project delivery.

Angi needs a senior enablement owner who can change sales behavior and measure business impact—not simply deliver training. Jacqueline's instructional design and scalable training background is relevant; verify strategic-selling fluency, independent program ownership, facilitation, AI-enabled analysis, and measured sales outcomes.
